verifications.note: url_verifier.py raised SSLError (cert-chain: 'unable to verify the first certificate') — a documented false-negative pattern. Manually confirmed via curl -k: HTTP 200, subject=Egyptian Natural Gas Company (GASCO, official domain), body contains 'Salam' and pipeline description.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Original cited ref (egyptoil-gas.com/reports/the-western-desert-egypts-giant-petroleum-reservoir/) returns HTTP 200 but is a scanned/graphic magazine-layout PDF with no extractable text supporting 'Salam' or pipeline status — correctly flagged DEAD_LINK-equivalent (no usable content), so replaced. New refs: (1) Egypt Oil & Gas news article (19 Apr 2026) reporting Petroleum Minister/Khalda tour 'inspected production operations at the Salam field, operated by Khalda Petroleum Company' — confirms the field/plant is actively producing now (operating). (2) GASCO's own Western Desert Gas Complex page states gas from 'Salam, Tarek and El-qasr (Khalda Petroleum Company)' fields 'are transported to the complex through a pipeline of 34 inches in diameter and 230 km in length,' operational since May 2000 with a 2010 capacity expansion — describes the Salam feed pipeline as a live, currently-operating asset. Both independent (Egyptian trade press vs. Egyptian state gas utility), neither traces to GEM. No contradiction found on status; both corroborate 'operating.'

No prior ref existed (UNRESOLVED in brief). Searched egyptoil-gas.com, Oil & Gas Journal, offshore-technology.com, GASCO, MIGA/Apache EIAs, academic (ScienceDirect/ResearchGate) papers on the Salam field, and Wikipedia's Matrouh Governorate page — none of those state the Matrouh/Marsa Matrouh province tie explicitly (most only say 'Western Desert' / 'Khalda Concession'). Found a directly on-point independent source: Tenaris's licensee-network directory lists the Weatherford facility there as 'Khalda El salam Base - Marsa Matrouh - Egypt' / 'Western desert, Marsa Matrouh' — a service-company location listing, independent of GEM, that ties Salam explicitly to Marsa Matrouh (=Matruh Governorate), Western Desert, Egypt, matching StartLocation/EndLocation=Salam, District=Western Desert, Province=Matruh, Country=Egypt. Only one qualifying independent source found for the specific Matruh tie (GASCO and OGJ corroborate Salam=Western Desert/Khalda but do not name the governorate), so tier is medium rather than high. No contradiction found; StartLocation=EndLocation=Salam in the brief is consistent with this being a short spur/lateral at the Salam field/plant rather than a point-to-point trunk line.
